script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. MORNING - SMALL TOWN - 7:15 AM

A small picturesque town, with trees lining the streets and a calm river running through it. Birds are chirping, and the sun is gently rising.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - 7:30 AM

JASON (early 30s, dressed in a simple sweater and jeans) enters the coffee shop. He orders a cappuccino and takes a seat at the bar. The barista, SARAH (late 20s, with short curly hair and a friendly smile), makes his drink and places it in front of him.

JASON
Good morning, Sarah.

SARAH
Good morning, Jason. How's your day going to be?

JASON
(smiling) Same old, same old. Just another day at the mill.

INT. MILL - 8:00 AM

Jason arrives at the mill, a large, industrial building in the heart of town. He clocks in at the time clock and heads to the factory floor. The machines are humming, and the air is thick with the smell of wood.

INT. FACTORY FLOOR - 8:15 AM

Jason takes a seat at his workbench, surrounded by other workers. They exchange pleasantries as they begin their day.

WORKER 1 (middle-aged, with a weathered face and calloused hands)
Morning, Jason. Heard you took a bad fall last weekend.

JASON
(laughs) It was nothing. Just a little scrape. I'm good as new.

WORKER 2 (elderly, with a kind face and spectacles)
I remember when I was your age. I thought I was invincible too.

INT. BREAK ROOM - 10:15 AM

During the break, Jason and his coworkers gather in the break room. They eat their lunches and chat about their lives.

WORKER 3 (young, with a mischievous grin)
Hey Jason, did you hear about the new girl starting at the mill today?

JASON
No, I haven't. Who is she?

WORKER 3
Her name's Samantha. She's fresh out of college. I heard she's pretty smart.

JASON
(smiling) That's great. We could use some new talent around here.

INT. FACTORY FLOOR - 1:30 PM

Jason helps Samantha get settled in at her workstation. They work together, and he shows her the ropes. She's eager to learn and asks him questions about the mill and the town.

INT. MILL ENTRANCE - 4:00 PM

As the day ends, Jason and Samantha walk out of the mill together. They chat about their shared experiences and the town's history.

SAMANTHA
This town has such a rich history. I can't wait to explore it more.

JASON
(smiling) You'll love it here. It's a great place to call home.

EXT. TOWN SQUARE - 6:00 PM

Jason and Samantha meet up at the town square, where people are gathered for a community event. They watch as locals perform traditional dances and play music.

SAMANTHA
I can see why you love it here, Jason.

JASON
(looking at her) And I can see why you'll fit in perfectly.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - 8:00 PM

Jason and Samantha sit at a table in the coffee shop, sipping their drinks. They talk about their hopes and dreams for the future.

SAMANTHA
I'm so glad I came here, Jason. You've been so kind and helpful.

JASON
(smiling) That's just the way it is in this town. We look out for each other.

INT. JASON'S APARTMENT - 10:00 PM

Jason goes home to an empty apartment. He sits at the kitchen table, lost in thought. The phone rings, and it's Samantha.

SAMANTHA (V.O.)
Hey Jason, I had a great time today. Thanks for being so nice to me.

JASON
(smiling) It was my pleasure, Samantha.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
